dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description: The name of the field to which these settings apply

yAxisTitle.description:
The title to be shown above the yAxis line. This will override {@link UiSdlLineBarChartYAxisConfig#name}
default yAxis line title

yAxisStyleOverride.description: An object that contains some overrides for Y Axis config such as Y Axis name location, rotation and gap.

legendLabel.description: The label to be shown in the legend.

legendDescription.description: The description of the legend label on hover

legendIcon.description: The icon of all legend items

color.description: The default color to be shown for this data series.

colorConfigurationStrategy.description:
The strategy used for determining the colors of the bars. Currently, only gradient coloring is supported.
If this field is set, {@link color} is ignored.

visualizationType.description:
The type of visualization. It could be either 'UiSdlLineBarChartBarVisualization', 'UiSdlLineBarChartPointVisualization' or 'UiSdlCategoricalLineBarChartLineVisualization'.
To config it at json file, put visualization type value at "type" field alongside with other fields from the reference type.
For example:
    "visualizationType": {
      "type": "UiSdlCategoricalLineBarChartLineVisualization",
      "lineStyle": "Dotted"
    }

title:
A specification that describes how to use each field of the {@link dataType} for display in the {@link UiSdlCategoricalLineBarChart}.
A single field is mapped to either X axis or Y axis, so an instance of this type specifies how to display the Y axis
in a categorical line bar chart.
name: UiSdlCategoricalLineBarChartYAxisDataSpecSetting
